meta.inspection: All 25 images individually opened using view_image. No source, key or other judges read. Own prior image hashes used solely to preserve exact unchanged scores.
meta.blinding_limitations: Repeated controls and visual families recognizable. Sci-fi resembles StarCraft, battlefields Company of Heroes; tactical title uncertain. No presumed improvement or novelty reward.

view-01.png.evidence: Metal ships and cool rock contrast with layered bright explosion.
view-01.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Blast obscures units; purple forms merge with foliage. Unchanged reference.

view-02.png.evidence: Service apron, runway and roads organize the base; blue roofs and tree contacts provide depth.
view-02.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: No material phone-size improvement versus near-match prior base. Blue aircraft overlaps matching hangar; fine water contrasts with simple land; heavy tree shadows persist.

view-03.png.evidence: Crisp runway edges, hangar sidewalls, compound lanes and varied ocean remain visible.
view-03.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: No score-level difference from prior crisp base. Aircraft remains hard to separate from middle blue roof; large flat apron and noisy grass remain.

view-04.png.evidence: Distinct floors, wall depth, warm/cool light and furniture contacts.
view-04.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Tiny units/text demanding at phone size. Unchanged reference.

view-05.png.evidence: Aircraft outline remains visible beside rocks; shaded trees and varied dark water add depth.
view-05.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Beach is abrupt narrow strip with segmented upper transitions; flat ground and heavy circular tree contacts contrast with detailed sea. Soft edges limit precision.

view-06.png.evidence: Dark water provides background contrast to pale aircraft and orange impacts; deck remains traceable.
view-06.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Numerous equal fire specks, smoke dots and overlapping planes obscure priorities; lower-resolution edges reduce separation on deck.

view-07.png.evidence: Broad apron, service lanes and raised blue roofs establish functional base; dark blue ocean adds material depth.
view-07.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Blue player still merges with blue hangar. Noisy grass, abrupt shore segments and strong tree contacts remain; water realism exceeds polygonal land style.

view-08.png.evidence: Raised island, deck seams and dark hull establish carrier volume against deeper-looking ocean.
view-08.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player partly merges with runway marks; wake remains repeated puffs and sea fine texture competes with more schematic vessel shading.

view-09.png.evidence: Outlined aircraft beside rocks, dimensional tree crowns and dark sea remain clear.
view-09.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Near-match coast has no material quality change at display size. Narrow beach still abruptly cuts detailed water; heavy tree contact shadows remain.

view-10.png.evidence: Dark ocean separates pale planes; deck panels, raised island and shaded hull give depth. Tiny orange impact flares read.
view-10.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Planes on tan deck overlap markings; repeated wake puffs and broad shadows remain. High-frequency water competes with small sprites.

view-11.png.evidence: Wet reflections, rain, tracer and smoke unify rich rubble/mud.
view-11.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Dark units merge with terrain. Unchanged reference.

view-12.png.evidence: Service apron and roads structure base; dark sea provides a clear coastline boundary.
view-12.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player nearly merges with middle blue hangar; grass uniform, tree shadows heavy, coastline sharply segmented. Fallback softness reduces material separation.

view-13.png.evidence: Crisp plane outline, dimensional rocks and tree crowns; varied ocean adds surface depth.
view-13.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Fine water texture contrasts with simple beach and flat grass. Coast still looks a cut edge with an abrupt stepped color transition at top.

view-14.png.evidence: Player and carrier recognizable, deck seams and runway marks readable; raised island remains.
view-14.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Tan deck has expanded into a rounded slab that covers nearly all perimeter and side shading. Dark bow fragment protrudes below as a mismatched triangle. Carrier looks flatter and less structurally coherent than rimmed control; wake still repeated puffs.

view-15.png.evidence: Warm shadowed market with produce/props and traceable colored routes.
view-15.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Small brown figures merge into surroundings. Unchanged reference.

view-16.png.evidence: Sparse composition and light deck against dark sea keep the scene readable.
view-16.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Broad rounded tan deck obscures hull sides and dark rim; exposed dark triangle at near end looks disconnected. Softer edges further reduce volume. Clear depth/coherence regression from rimmed carrier.

view-17.png.evidence: Layered fog, trees, tracks and damaged buildings give rich depth.
view-17.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Units merge with ground/haze. Unchanged reference.

view-18.png.evidence: Dark water frames light carrier and planes; large controls and compact orange flares remain readable.
view-18.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Soft aircraft edges merge into deck marks. Water is busier than quieter retained controls; wake has repeated oval segments.

view-19.png.evidence: Player outline and coast separation readable; muted trees and runway form coherent scene.
view-19.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: No meaningful improvement from prior soft coast. Flat grass, abrupt beach strip and strong repeated tree shadows persist.

view-20.png.evidence: Pale aircraft and orange impacts remain distinguishable against dark sea; HUD clear.
view-20.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Carrier deck now resembles a flat rounded board; lost dark perimeter weakens sidewall depth. Pale planes still merge with deck markings. Wake and smoke remain repetitive.

view-21.png.evidence: Sparse composition, dark hull edge, readable raised island and light player silhouette on sea.
view-21.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player overlaps tan deck at bow; repetitive segmented wake and soft carrier edges. Dark detailed ocean lacks corresponding deck lighting complexity.

view-22.png.evidence: Pale plane silhouettes contrast against dark textured sea; orange impacts and thin smoke have defined forms.
view-22.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Many equal orange flecks and crossing planes fragment attention. Player near bow remains crowded; smoke rosettes and repeated wake puffs look stamped.

view-23.png.evidence: Crisp aircraft outlines, small orange impacts and island details remain visible.
view-23.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Rounded tan deck overhang conceals hull rim and side depth, with an isolated dark triangle below near end. Lighting/material regression versus matched rimmed carrier; overlap on pale deck persists.

view-24.png.evidence: Dark sea separates pale aircraft; bright impact flecks and thin smoke are visible.
view-24.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Dense scene still lacks effect hierarchy; added flat tan deck shape loses believable hull attachment and peripheral shading. Repeated smoke rosettes and wake ovals remain.

view-25.png.evidence: Large controls remain clear; planes and orange impacts contrast with dark water.
view-25.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Flattened rounded carrier deck and missing hull rim weaken structure. Soft crowded aircraft merge over deck; many equal fire spots and smoke stamps obscure priorities.

general_next_priorities: Restore a coherent carrier deck-to-hull relationship: visible narrow rim, continuous sidewall value and connected bow silhouette. Avoid an unshaded rounded overlay concealing structure.
Retain land scores until a visible improvement exists; focus on player/hangar contrast and shore transitions.
Separate major impacts from equal orange spark clutter in dense scenes.
Reduce water microtexture competition and replace puff-chain wakes with connected irregular foam.
